FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #11
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'au revoir' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Sir, Mr
   B. goodbye
   C. Pleased to meet you
   D. hi, bye

2. What does 'la grand-mère' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the baby
   B. the grandfather
   C. the grandmother
   D. the girl

3. How do you say 'This is my mother.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. C'est le bébé.
   B. C'est ma sœur.
   C. C'est ma mère.
   D. Ma mère s'appelle Grace.

4. How do you say 'My sister is called Njeri.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Ma mère s'appelle Grace.
   B. C'est ma sœur.
   C. Ma sœur s'appelle Njeri.
   D. Mon frère s'appelle Kamau.

5. Fill in: Le chat est ______ la chaise. (under) (1 mark)
   A. devant
   B. sous
   C. entre
   D. sur

6. How do you say 'The cat is under the chair.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il y a un canapé dans le salon.
   B. Le sac est dans la chambre.
   C. Où est le chat ?
   D. Le chat est sous la chaise.

7. What does 'devant' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. between
   B. in front of
   C. on
   D. in

8. What does 'je me repose' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. I rest
   B. tomorrow
   C. today
   D. I sing

9. What does 'l'école' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the day
   B. the week
   C. the school
   D. the church

10. What does 'samedi' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Thursday
   B. Saturday
   C. Wednesday
   D. Tuesday

11. Read: Amina: Bonjour, Kamau ! Bon anniversaire ! Kamau: Merci, Amina ! Amina: Tu as quel âge ? Kamau: J'ai dix ans. Amina: Voici un cadeau ! Question: What does Amina give Kamau? (1 mark)
   A. a cake
   B. a song
   C. a balloon
   D. a present

12. Which month is 'novembre'? (1 mark)
   A. June
   B. December
   C. November
   D. October

13. What number is 'huit' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 18
   C. 10
   D. 8

14. What does 'le gâteau' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the cake
   B. water
   C. maize
   D. the mango

15. What does 'les frites' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. milk
   B. fruits
   C. chips
   D. fish

16. What does 'le bras' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the foot
   B. the ear
   C. the shoulder
   D. the arm

17. What does 'le vent' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the wind
   B. the sun
   C. the weather
   D. the cloud

18. How do you say 'The fridge is in the kitchen.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le frigo est dans la cuisine.
   B. Où est la clé ?
   C. Excusez-moi, où est l'école ?
   D. Allez tout droit.

19. What does 'C'est ma sœur.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. My mother is called Grace.
   B. This is my brother.
   C. This is my father.
   D. This is my sister.

20. Read: Je m'appelle Amina. J'ai un frère et une sœur. Mon frère s'appelle Kamau. Ma sœur s'appelle Njeri. Question: Who is Njeri? (1 mark)
   A. Amina's sister
   B. Amina's friend
   C. Amina's grandmother
   D. Amina's mother

21. What does 'C'est ma mère.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my mother.
   B. Who is it?
   C. It is the baby.
   D. My brother is called Kamau.

22. Which little word goes with 'frigo' (the fridge)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. les
   C. la
   D. le

23. What does 'Le samedi, j'aide ma mère.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Friday, I dance.
   B. On Thursday, I sing.
   C. On Saturday, I help my mother.
   D. Tomorrow it is Thursday.

24. Which little word goes with 'chanson'? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. la
   C. l'
   D. les

25. Which food is good for your health? (1 mark)
   A. les chips
   B. les bonbons
   C. l'eau
   D. les frites

26. Which little word goes with 'jus' (the juice)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. le
   C. la
   D. l'

27. Which little word goes with 'poulet' (the chicken)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. les
   C. l'
   D. la

28. Which little word goes with 'cou' (the neck)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. l'
   C. la
   D. le

29. Which little word goes with 'nez' (the nose)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. le
   C. les
   D. l'

30. What does 'Il y a du soleil.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is sunny.
   B. It is cold.
   C. Today it is raining.
   D. What is the weather like?

31. What does 'Aujourd'hui, il pleut.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Tomorrow the weather is nice.
   B. It is snowing.
   C. I stay in the house.
   D. Today it is raining.

32. How do you say 'yes' in French? (1 mark)
   A. oui
   B. Enchanté
   C. Madame
   D. bonsoir

33. How do you say 'the father' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le père
   B. le bébé
   C. la grand-mère
   D. la sœur

34. How do you say 'the child' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la sœur
   B. la famille
   C. l'enfant
   D. la mère

35. How do you say 'under' in French? (1 mark)
   A. entre
   B. devant
   C. sur
   D. sous

36. How do you say 'I sing' in French? (1 mark)
   A. hier
   B. je me repose
   C. je chante
   D. demain

37. How do you write the number 31 in French? (1 mark)
   A. onze
   B. treize
   C. trente et un
   D. dix-neuf

38. How do you say 'the snow' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la neige
   B. une inondation
   C. l'orage
   D. le vent

39. How do you say 'the weather' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le temps
   B. l'orage
   C. la pluie
   D. une inondation

40. How do you say 'You are welcome' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Excusez-moi
   B. Allez
   C. Tournez
   D. De rien

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Translate into English: 'C'est mon frère.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

42. Translate into English: 'Comment tu t'appelles ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

43. Translate into English: 'Il est sur la table.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

44. Translate into English: 'Où est la clé ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Write three instructions in French to tell a friend where to put things in a room. (5 marks) (5 marks)

46. Translate into English: 'Elle a les cheveux noirs.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

47. Translate into French: 'I have a nose.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

48. Translate into English: 'La porte est à côté de la fenêtre.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

49. Translate into French: 'Here is my grandfather.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

50. Translate into English: 'Il y a un gâteau et des ballons.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

51. Translate into French: 'The weather is nice.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

52. Translate into French: 'They are mangoes.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

53. Translate into French: 'Where is the cat?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

54. Translate into French: 'The TV is on the table.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

55. Translate into English: 'C'est mon père.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

56. Translate into French: 'My brother is called Kamau.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

57. Translate into English: 'C'est le bébé.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

58. Translate into French: 'There is a sofa in the living room.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

59. Translate into English: 'C'est ma sœur.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

60. Translate into English: 'Aujourd'hui, il pleut.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

61. Translate into English: 'Le samedi, je joue.' (3 marks) (3 marks)
